# Project References

## Reference 1 -- Investor account opening portal (2019)

Client: a Riyadh-based brokerage licensed by the Capital Market Authority. The
client has agreed to be named to prospective customers on request.

Delivered: March to August 2019. Fixed price. Team of five.

Scope: a bilingual Arabic and English portal for individual investors to open
a brokerage account online. Six-step application form with around 35 fields,
upload of national ID and supporting documents, email verification, and an
administration back-office where compliance staff review, approve or return
applications. Built in C# ASP.NET MVC on SQL Server, hosted by the client on
Windows Server 2016.

Not in scope: SMS verification (the client used email only), integration with
the client's bank for payments, and generation of signed agreements. The
application was captured online and the investor signed paper forms at a
branch.

## Reference 2 -- Municipal permit request forms (2022)

Client: a municipal services department in Jeddah.

Delivered: January to May 2022. Team of four.

Scope: eleven online request forms in Arabic and English with a workflow
routing each request between three departments, status tracking for the
applicant, and PDF generation of the approved permit in both languages. Built
in ASP.NET Core on SQL Server.

Load testing: before go-live we load tested the public forms at 150 concurrent
users with Apache JMeter. Average response time was 1.4 seconds and no errors
were recorded. The test report was delivered to the client.

This client has not given permission to be named. Contact details can be
shared under non-disclosure only.
